headword: {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}

definitions.gloss: family care leave; leave of absence from work to care for a family member
definitions.explanation: A statutory leave of absence in Japan that allows employees to stop working temporarily in order to care for a family member who requires nursing care due to illness, injury, or old age. Under Japanese law, eligible workers may take up to 93 days of {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} per family member needing care.

⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for family care leave in order to look after my mother.

notes:
A specific legal category of leave under the Japanese ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧・{介護休業法|かいごきゅうぎょうほう} (Child Care and Family Care Leave Act). Distinct from everyday use of 'care leave' in English: in Japan, {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} has a defined legal meaning, eligibility, and benefit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take family care leave
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain family care leave
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: the family care leave system
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}{給付金|きゅうふきん}: family care leave benefit (paid by employment insurance)
- {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during family care leave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}→介護休暇：08566_kaigokyuuka⟧: family care days off — a separate, shorter-term leave (up to 5 days per family member per year) for day-to-day care needs
- ⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧: childcare leave — a parallel system for caring for young children
- ⟦{産休|さんきゅう}→産休：06997_sankyuu⟧: maternity leave — a shortened form of {産前産後休業|さんぜんさんごきゅうぎょう}
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧: (nursing) care — the broader activity of caring for someone who needs support

CULTURAL NOTE:
With Japan's rapidly aging population, the {介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう} system has become an increasingly important labor issue. Companies are legally required to allow eligible workers to take this leave, though in practice many employees hesitate to use it due to workplace pressure.
